questions.text:
Draw an ER diagram for the airport database scenario described below and identify the relationships between entities. 

The airline has a customer database with customer information such as id, name, age, phone number, flight reservations (flight number and customer id), flights (flight number, from, to, departure time, arrival time, aircraft registration number, pilot id) and pilots (pilot id, name, salary, flying hours).

Consider the following schema of a database developed for an airport. 

Customer (customerId: integer, name: varchar (30), age: int, phone: char (10)) 
Reservations (flno: char (6), custId: integer) 
Flights (flno: char (6), from: varchar (30), to: varchar (30), departs: datetime, arrives: datetime, regNo: char (8), pilotId: integer) 
Aircraft (regNo: char (8), model: varchar (15), capacity: integer, Pilots (id: integer, name: varchar (30), salary: float, flyingHours: integer)

The Aircraft table stores the registration number (regNo), model (model) and the number of passengers who can travel in the aircraft (capacity) for each aircraft type. The Flights table stores the flight number (flno), the departing airport (from), destination airport (to), departing time (departs), arrival time (arrives), the registration number of the aircraft (regNo) and the id of the pilot (pilot) related to all flights. Reservations table stores the flight number (flno) and the customer number (custId) for each customer who has reserved a flight. Pilots table stores the id (id), name (name), salary (salary) and the number of hours the pilot have flown (flyingHours) for each pilot. Primary keys of the tables are underlined.

Draw an ER diagram that represents the relationships between entities in the airport database scenario. 

(10 marks)
Consider a relation R (A, B, C, D, E, F, G) with the following set of functional dependencies over R: F = {A->BC, B->D, C->EF, AC->G}. Compute the keys for relation R.

Consider the relation schema Investment (A, W, O, L, S, D) with the following functional dependencies: FD1: L → D, FD2: A → W, FD3: {O,L} → {A,S}. Determine which of the following sets of attributes is a candidate key for the relation. Choose all that apply.

(a) {A,W,D}
(b) {L,O,A,S}
(c) {W,D}
(d) {A,L,S}
(e) None of the above
(f) All of the above
